intelligence.human_view: The emblem was the corners and the official areas; now it is the mark of the premium everywhere it makes sense. His point is about the feeling a citizen gets before they read a word: they see the symbol, they see the icon, and they feel "oh yeah, this is a high-end rich premium interface." The emblem does that work because it looks for real (SN-3157) — a crowned jewel with wings, placed elegantly, makes the whole surface read high-end. Elegantly is the constraint that keeps it from becoming wallpaper: not everywhere, not stamped on everything — all the places that make sense, sitting as a real object, in the spots where the premium needs to be felt.
intelligence.simple_view: Put the pretty emblem all over NayaNET — in the Dashboard, in the day-by-day, everywhere it makes sense! Then everybody feels: wow, this is a fancy premium place, just from looking at the symbol!
intelligence.grandma_view: Put the pretty emblem all over NayaNET, dear — in the Dashboard, in the day-by-day, everywhere it makes sense! Then everybody feels: wow, this is a fancy premium place, just from looking at the symbol!
